title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: redesigned on-device admin settings
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, licensing context and control references are supported. The PowerShell calls are documented and clearly identified as historical, unsupported automation. Two minor corrections remain: complete the shortened portal path in the prose and remove the checklist's licence-stocktaking step, which has no controls-table row.

claims.claim: Current Android on-device settings include Teams Admin Settings > General > Bluetooth beaconing.
claims.quote: On a Teams Rooms on Android device, open Teams Admin Settings > General > toggle Bluetooth beaconing to Off as desired.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: The Android console path is Teams Admin Settings > Meetings > Show meeting names.
claims.quote: On a Teams Rooms on Android device, open Teams Admin Settings > Meetings and toggle Show meeting names to Off to hide meeting names on the Teams Rooms device.

claims.claim: The Android console path to the passcode control is Teams Admin Settings > Meetings > Require passcode for all meetings.
claims.quote: On Teams Rooms on Android devices, open Teams Admin Settings > Meetings and toggle Require passcode for all meetings to On to require room users to enter the meeting credentials to join all scheduled Teams meetings.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Requiring meeting credentials on the room device requires a Teams Rooms Pro licence on its account.
claims.quote: This feature requires the account on the device to have a Teams Rooms Pro license.

claims.claim: The Teams Rooms Pro Management portal path is Rooms > device > Settings > category > setting.
claims.quote: Go to Rooms/ Phones in the left navigation and click the device you want to configure. Select the Settings tab in the device panel. Use the left navigation in the device panels to browse settings categories (About, Account, Meetings, Device, Network, etc.).

claims.claim: Rooms > device > Settings in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal is a place to change device settings.
claims.quote: Select the Settings tab in the device panel. Use the left navigation in the device panels to browse settings categories (About, Account, Meetings, Device, Network, etc.). Modify the desired settings using the form fields.
claims.fix: Replace the prose path 'Rooms > device > Settings' with 'Rooms > device > Settings > category > setting', matching controls[0].ui and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/pro-portal-settings.
